hypotheses.construction_plan: Let F(z)=polygamma(0,z). The first term is Identity[F](z). The second term is d/dz F(z), which equals polygamma(1,z). The raw expression is the sum of these two operator images.
required_assumptions: polygamma(0,z) is differentiable in the relevant domain
proof_obligations: polygamma(0, z) + polygamma(1, z) - (F(z) + d/dz F(z)) = 0
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are successive polygamma orders; polygamma(1,z) is the derivative of polygamma(0,z), so the expression is exactly F + F'.
